title: reshape-request.json v1
description: The sole orchestrate→plan data contract: makato-plan reads only this file (plus board Status and label) to re-shape a story after repeated structural failures. Written by scripts/emit-reshape-request.sh after a structural HALT fires. One file per issue at specs/<key>-<slug>/reshape-request.json. The PO-agent is the sole writer.

schema_version.description: Schema version for forward-compatibility detection. Always 'v1' for this schema version.

issue_key.description: Composite key for the issue in the form '<number>-<slug>' (e.g. '349-makato-orchestrate-serialize-structural'). Matches the specs folder name suffix and is the canonical identifier used across build.jsonl and orchestrate.jsonl log entries.

issue_number.description: GitHub Issue number this reshape request was generated for.

issue_slug.description: Human-readable slug component of the issue key (e.g. 'makato-orchestrate-serialize-structural'). Derived from the issue title by to-issues and stored in the specs folder name.

structural_halt_cycles.description: Count of structural HALT events that have fired for this issue in the current PO-agent run. Structural HALTs are: HALT-003 (CRITICAL diff-reviewer findings or STRUCTURAL PR comments), HALT-STRUCTURAL (coder returned failure with data.escalation='refine'), HALT-010 (human_review_cycles ceiling), and HALT-008 with data.origin == 'outer_iteration' (re-plan budget exhausted). Other HALT-008 origins (merge_conflict, ci_failure) are NOT structural — they are transient operational failures, not story-shape failures.

reshape_cycles.description: Count of times makato-plan's reshape path has been invoked for this issue (i.e. how many prior reshape-request.json files have been emitted and acted upon). 0 on the first reshape. Allows makato-plan to detect runaway reshaping loops.

halt_history.description: Filtered subset of workflow-state.json halt_audit[] — only structural HALT entries. Structural HALTs are those with code in: 'HALT-003', 'HALT-STRUCTURAL', 'HALT-010', or 'HALT-008' where data.origin == 'outer_iteration'. Non-structural HALTs (HALT-007, HALT-007B, HALT-000, HALT-009, etc.) are excluded. Each entry is a verbatim copy of the halt_audit shape from workflow-state.schema.json.

code.description: Structural HALT code string. One of: 'HALT-003', 'HALT-STRUCTURAL', 'HALT-010', or 'HALT-008' (only when data.origin == 'outer_iteration').

ts.description: ISO-8601 timestamp with millisecond precision when the structural HALT fired.

data.description: HALT-code-specific context payload. Shape varies per code — consumers must tolerate unknown keys. For HALT-008 entries, data.origin must equal 'outer_iteration' to qualify as structural.

retryable.description: Copied from halt_audit[].retryable: whether the loop can auto-retry once the triggering condition resolves. Absent on legacy entries.

origin.description: Copied from halt_audit[].origin: who must act to unblock this HALT. Absent on legacy entries.

retry_after_secs.description: Copied from halt_audit[].retry_after_secs: suggested wait before a re-attempt when retryable. Absent when not applicable.

lessons_trail.description: Filtered subset of workflow-state.json lessons_learned[] — only entries where trigger == 'halt'. These are structural-trigger lessons: observations recorded when a HALT-* code fired (including HALT-STRUCTURAL). Lessons with other triggers (ci_failure, review_comment, sensor, merge_conflict) are excluded because they capture transient operational failures, not story-shape problems that makato-plan can address. Each entry is a verbatim copy of the lessons_learned item shape from workflow-state.schema.json.

ts.description: ISO-8601 timestamp with millisecond precision when the lesson was appended.

cycle.description: Outer-loop iteration count at the moment the lesson was recorded (mirrors workflow-state.outer_iteration). 0 is valid for lessons recorded before the first re-plan.

trigger.description: Always 'halt' for lessons in this array — the filter criterion. A 'halt' lesson is recorded whenever a HALT-* code fires, including HALT-STRUCTURAL.

description.description: Structured one-line summary of what happened when the HALT fired. Under 200 chars — structured, not narrative.

files_affected.description: Repo-relative paths the cycle touched at the time the HALT fired. Empty array when not applicable.

last_critical_errors.description: OPTIONAL. Absent when the most recent sub-task has no CRITICAL errors. When present, contains the string items from agent_result.errors of the most recent completed sub-task where the errors are classified as CRITICAL (e.g. 'STRUCTURAL_BLOCKER: ...' or 'MISSING_INPUT: ...'). Sourced from workflow-state.json sub_tasks[-1].agent_result.errors filtered to CRITICAL-severity strings. Provides makato-plan with the exact coder error messages to inform the reshape strategy.

items.description: A single CRITICAL error string from the most recent sub-task's agent_result.errors array.

emitted_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when this reshape-request.json was written by emit-reshape-request.sh. Records the exact moment the PO-agent decided a structural reshape was required.
